resources.string: Translates on-screen text in real time
ScreenTranslator reads the text visible on your screen and overlays a translation. All processing happens on-device; nothing leaves your phone.

To translate text on your screen, ScreenTranslator needs to be enabled as an accessibility service. This lets the app read what is on the screen and draw the translation on top.\n\nAll processing runs on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
Look for a small red marker in the top-right corner of any app. That is the overlay window drawn by the accessibility service.
